title: Cem Karsan Explains Why Bonds Rallied on a Hot CPI Report
speaker: Cem Karsan (guest)

macro_themes.view: Bonds rallied as a risk-off flight to safety and bond vol compressed, even though the bond market is the source of stress.
Stress broadens into markets approaching the midterms; Trump's depression warnings are a green light to the bears.
Host: hyperscalers and governments compete for long-end funds; weaker AI spend could ease long-end pressure.

calls.reason: Approaching midterms, stress spreads into markets and Trump is signaling he wants the market down while positioning is long.
calls.quote: once we approach the midterms, the stress starts coming into the market more broadly.

calls.reason: Risk-off flight to safety into bonds plus bond-vol compression; yields falling despite hot CPI, but action 'muddy'.
calls.quote: this is a risk-off move... The bond market is the cause of the stress, yet it is also the flight to safety

notes: Date inferred: hot September CPI day (Oct 14). TNX bias is for yields (bearish = yields down) inferred from 'flight to safety'; Karsan calls it muddy, low conviction. Transcript cuts off mid-interview.
